WITH scan_site_match AS (
  SELECT s.gbsize, s.spanmin, s.zoneref, site.healtheval
  FROM scans s
  INNER JOIN sites site ON s.zoneref = site.zoneregistry
),
status_stats AS (
  SELECT healtheval,
    AVG(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin != 0
      THEN gbsize / spanmin ELSE NULL END) as avg_rate,
    COUNT(DISTINCT zoneref) as distinct_sites
  FROM scan_site_match
  GROUP BY healtheval
),
all_status_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate) as overall_avg_rate
  FROM status_stats
  WHERE avg_rate IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_statuses AS (
  SELECT ss.avg_rate, ss.distinct_sites, asa.overall_avg_rate
  FROM status_stats ss
  CROSS JOIN all_status_avg asa
  WHERE asa.overall_avg_rate IS NOT NULL AND ss.avg_rate > asa.overall_avg_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_rate) as avg_rate,
  AVG(distinct_sites) as avg_distinct_sites,
  AVG(avg_rate - overall_avg_rate) as avg_excess
FROM filtered_statuses
